capabilities: append an Activities section to daily notes on a configurable interval
write distance and time metrics to frontmatter fields
backfill up to 90 days of historical activities
detect daily notes from Periodic Notes or Daily Notes plugins
disambiguation: Not a note-syncing tool; 'sync' here means pulling Strava activities into daily notes, not syncing notes between devices.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store (under review); install via BRAT or manually. README warns not to clone the repo into the vault (node_modules breaks iCloud sync) and to keep data.json when updating.
problem: Daily notes don't automatically capture your Strava workouts, so activity data has to be copied into notes by hand.

relations.evidence: Sync your Strava activities to Obsidian daily notes with OAuth2 authentication.
